purpose: Tall transparent decorative snake beneath the WAR banner, left gutter, with tail near the beginning of the blue MOMENTS ribbon.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original character illustration, a tall vertically posed snake for the left margin of Rudy Hartt's black art-portfolio website. Genuine transparent background. Portrait canvas approximately 1:3 width to height, with the complete snake and tongue entirely inside frame and a little transparent padding. The snake is viewed strictly from the SIDE, facing LEFT toward the outside of the page. Its small head is near the top; ONE expressive black eye on the visible outward-facing side, close to the left edge of the head. The open mouth is a clean triangular cut-out notch in the left-facing profile. A bright RED long FORKED TONGUE waves out to the LEFT in a graceful little curl, clearly separated into two tips. Body is vivid warm YELLOW with a bold hand-painted BLACK continuous ZIGZAG pattern running the length of its back. Long elegant upright serpentine S-shaped body descends through two or three gentle bends to a slender curved tail near the bottom; keep the silhouette tall and relatively narrow, not a coiled horizontal snake. Playful graphic street-art character, painted cut-paper collage illustration: tactile gouache and oil-pastel grain, worn ink outlines, subtle pencil scuffs, charming simple shapes, strong readable yellow-black contrast, matching textured contemporary illustrated characters. Entire figure, no cropping. No ground, no shadow on a surface, no scenery, no frame, no text, no additional objects or characters. Do not make it photorealistic, glossy 3D, a dragon, a cobra hood, or a mascot with arms/legs. Keep the mouth a geometric triangular negative-space opening and the red forked tongue very legible.
processing: RGBA preserved; WebP conversion and a proportional 240px responsive variant only. No cropping or compositing.
